headline: Over 50 garment workers suddenly fall ill in Gazipur factory
summary: Workers were rushed to the hospital after a sudden health crisis at a clothing factory in Sreepur, Gazipur.
details: Over 50 workers suddenly fell ill at a garment factory in Sreepur, Gazipur, leading to a medical emergency.
The affected workers were immediately rushed to nearby hospitals for treatment.
Following the incident, the factory management declared a holiday for the remaining staff.
Reports indicate that journalists were obstructed from gathering further information at the scene.
caption:
Over 50 workers suddenly fell ill at a Gazipur factory. What happened?

Over 50 workers suddenly fell ill at a garment factory in Sreepur, Gazipur, leading to a medical emergency.

The affected workers were immediately rushed to nearby hospitals for treatment.

Following the incident, the factory management declared a holiday for the remaining staff.

Reports indicate that journalists were obstructed from gathering further information at the scene.

headline_marked: Microsoft [[cuts 4,800 jobs worldwide]] as Xbox division takes biggest hit
headline: Microsoft cuts 4,800 jobs worldwide as Xbox division takes biggest hit
summary: The tech giant is restructuring to meet evolving customer demands, with over 3,200 positions eliminated from its gaming sector.
details: Microsoft has announced the layoff of 4,800 employees globally, representing approximately 2.1% of its total workforce. The gaming division, Xbox, is the most heavily impacted by this move.

A total of 3,200 jobs will be cut from Xbox; 1,600 positions are being eliminated immediately, and another 1,600 will be removed over the next year. Xbox CEO Asha Sharma called this the largest restructuring in the division's history.
Executive Vice President Amy Coleman stated that the decision was driven by the need to focus on areas that can meet rapidly changing customer demands in the tech sector.
As part of the restructuring, four game development studios—Compulsion Games, Double Fine Productions, Ninja Theory, and Undead Labs—will now be operated independently.
While Amy Coleman acknowledged that AI is significantly changing work processes, she clarified that the eliminated positions will not be replaced by artificial intelligence.

The gaming industry is currently facing a widespread struggle, with many studios conducting layoffs over the last few years. Microsoft had previously cut over 2,000 jobs from Xbox in 2024 after acquiring Activision Blizzard.
The company is also increasing its investment of several billion dollars into AI, though it was not explicitly stated if these current layoffs are linked to that specific plan.
Analysts suggest that the restructuring is aimed at prioritizing popular game franchises and targeting a wider audience, while allowing some studios to operate independently to avoid total closure.
